test_title: PYST 138: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 30 Jan,, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

The boys are very (hyper) ______ today.
solution: The correct answer is **"tranquil."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Hyper" **means** **more than normal; too much, extremely excited or nervous. (असाधारण; अत्‍यधिक, अत्यधिक उत्साहित या घबराया हुआ) • **Example**:* I was so **hyper**__ it took me over an hour to get to sleep.* • **"Tranquil"** is the opposite of **"Hyper**." • **"Tranquil"** means calm or peaceful. (शांत या शांतिपूर्ण) __ • **Example**: *She stared at the **tranquil**__ surface of the water.* • The sentence suggests that the boys are behaving in a very energetic or overexcited manner. • The correct answer is Option 3. **Correct sentence**: *The boys are very __**tranquil**__ today.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Naughty: **(used when you are talking to or about a child) badly behaved; not obeying. ((बच्‍चों के विषय में प्रयुक्त) शरारती, नटखट; कहना न मानने वाला, उद्दंड) • **Hungry: **wanting to eat. (भोजन करने का इच्‍छुक; भूखा) • **Good: **of a high quality or standard. (उच्‍च गुणवत्ता या स्‍तर का, अच्‍छा) 38:Tc1f, The correct answer is **"Tame."**
